editorial_notes: New Thai explanation and synthetic examples, not a verbatim slide translation. no-ai-slop applied after drafting.
Preserve physical expected return versus risk-neutral valuation distinction.
Risk-free covariance is zero but correlation is undefined.
Absolute weights and volatility signs retained where shorting allowed. Lab is explicitly long-only.
Use CAL for a selected risky universe; CML requires market equilibrium assumptions.
Regression factor model, CAPM equilibrium and APT no-arbitrage pricing restrictions are distinguished.
Alpha is not standalone evidence of skill. Benchmark IR differs from appraisal ratio.
Equicorrelation matrix must be positive semidefinite; a fixed negative rho cannot be taken to an arbitrary N.
